G: guard only; no module writes G yet
L: guard only; no module writes L yet
N: guard only; no module writes N yet
V: guard only; the family engine's circulation clamp [.25, 1.9] is deliberately not adopted
W: guard only; no module writes W yet
k: guard only; no module writes K yet

KD-S1: lactate and respiratory rate: the core accumulates an oxygen-delivery debt D with first-order repayment (tau provisional, 60 min), counts haemoglobin and saturation in delivery, and derives RR from lactate (proposal §7.3); the family engine sets both instantly from circulation, with an RR floor of 14 in this family
faculty: tau of D, RR gain, whether RR follows lactate (Appendix A9)
KD-S2: heart rate after hemostasis: the family engine subtracts 20 bpm x hemostasis_relief from the displayed HR (a module writing an observable, which §8.1 rules out); the core has no channel through which recovery from controlled bleeding lowers the rate
faculty: which channel carries that recovery
KD-S3: consciousness at the 80 mmHg threshold: the family engine compares the rounded SBP (80), the core the raw value (79.9)
Observation v2 (Phase 1): thresholds on raw state or on the displayed value
KD-S4: volume beyond the family engine's circulation clamp [.25, 1.9] (+625 mL-eq): the engine stops the gain there; the core has no preload saturation yet, so pressure and rate keep moving (§7.3 asks for bounded gains)
faculty: shape and value of the volume-to-output plateau

debt_clearance_tau_min: no faculty value; the family engine's lactate has no kinetics
lactate_per_output_deficit: family_engine._diagnostic: lactate + (circulation - 1) * 2, reached here as the steady state of the debt D
pressure_levels: family_engine._PRESSURE_LEVELS, without the DC1 anchoring or the recovery margin, which belong to the observation layer
rr_per_lactate: legacy GI RR gain 15 per circulation unit / lactate 2 per unit; the structure (RR from lactate) is proposal §7.3, the value is not reviewed
volume_per_output_unit_ml: 300 mL per red-cell unit / 0.36 circulation per unit (family_engine.TRANSFUSION note; family_engine._minute)
